check_events.place: proof of c, final componentwise-inclusion argument
check_events.outcome: Conditional chain verified: assuming the cited figure-product componentwise-inclusion lemma, the stated equality of interior meanings, and downward closure of F′ in F, inclusion A′∩B′⊂A∩B gives A′⊂A and hence A′∈F′. Together with A′°∩B′°≠∅, this yields A′∩B′∈F′.G. No independent proof of the cited lemma is claimed.

check_events.type: carried as background without fault found

check_events.place: R3 check of unrestricted-set analogue of the cited lemma
check_events.outcome: Explicit finite counterexample: A={1,2}, B={1}, A′={1,3}, B′={1}. A∩B=A′∩B′={1}, yet 3∈A′ and 3∉A. Thus intersection inclusion alone does not imply componentwise inclusion for arbitrary sets; the manuscript’s special figure-product hypothesis is essential. This does not refute M02 or alter the transcription.
